plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v6.6.5: Bugfix — fix after_task crash on the effort signal (CC 2.1.133+ sends effort as a dict {"level":"high"}), so learns now reach the server. ace_after_task.py did `_EFFORT_WEIGHT.get(effort_level)` with the raw event value as a dict key; with effort delivered as a dict this raised `TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict'` and killed after_task BEFORE the ExecutionTrace was sent — for BOTH main (Stop) and subagent (SubagentStop) events, on essentially every event on CC >= 2.1.133. The crash sat between playbook_load logging and the learn call, which is exactly why traces reached the read step but never the server. Fix: new `_resolve_effort_level(event)` resolves the effort signal to a hashable string (effort-as-dict, effort-as-string, absent → CLAUDE_EFFORT env → "normal", and any non-string garbage → "normal"); main() now calls it. Impact: after_task completes through to `ace-cli learn` again → main and subagent ExecutionTraces actually reach the server (completes the v6.6.0/6.6.2/6.6.3/6.6.4 chain). Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.139, ace-cli >= 3.17.0 (@ace-sdk/core >= 2.19.0).
